
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lyhabc/p/23134321/automatic-index-compaction-sql-server" title="发布于 2026-10-10 08:00">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">自动数据库索引压缩合并</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 style="text-align: center;"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">自动数据库索引压缩合并</strong></h1>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">一直以来，我们都习惯在 SQL Server数据库实例中部署一项固定任务：<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">夜间或每周执行一次索引维护作业</strong>。我们先检查索引碎片率，碎片率介于5%～30%时执行索引重组（REORGANIZE），高于30%则执行索引重建（REBUILD），并且寄希望于该作业能够在业务日开始前执行完毕。当然，索引管理也没有一套通用的标准方案。有人也会使用Ola Hallengren的索引与统计信息维护脚本[https://ola.hallengren.com/sql-server-index-and-statistics-maintenance.html]</p>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">微软在2026年年初推出了一项新功能，该功能目前还在公开预览阶段：<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">自动数据库索引压缩合并（automatic index compaction）</strong>。数据库引擎会在数据发生变更时，于后台自动完成索引压缩合并工作，<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">无需人工维护作业、无需预留维护窗口、也不用维护脚本</strong>。</p>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h2 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: transparent; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: center; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: #e7642b; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; align-items: unset; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 3px 11px 3px 11px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">它能够解决哪些问题？</span></h2>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">自动索引压缩，是微软针对索引维护作业这一常规运维任务给出的合适解法。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">传统索引维护作业存在如下痛点：</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
CPU 和 I/O 开销巨大：索引重建需要读取并重写整个索引
</li>
<li>
执行耗时长，而可用的维护窗口持续缩短
</li>
<li>
会生成大量事务日志，对日志备份与 Always On 复制链路造成影响
</li>
<li>
可能阻塞业务应用：离线重建会锁定整张表；即便是在线重建，在任务起始与结束阶段也需要短暂的排他锁
</li>
<li>
需要专人部署、监控，作业失败时还要排查修复
</li>

</ul>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">还有一个不太容易被察觉的问题：多年来，这类维护作业一直在针对<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">错误指标</strong>做优化</p>
<h2 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: transparent; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: center; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: #e7642b; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; align-items: unset; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 3px 11px 3px 11px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">使用前提</span></h2>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">该功能目前处于公开预览，只支持部署在以下数据库服务：</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
Azure SQL 数据库
</li>
<li>
Azure SQL 托管实例（需开启Always-up-to-date更新策略）
</li>
<li>
Microsoft Fabric 中的 SQL 数据库
</li>

</ul>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">本地部署版 SQL Server（包括 SQL Server 2025）暂不支持该功能。</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">无需额外安装组件。该功能依托数据库引擎已在运行的后台线程（ADR 清理线程）实现；并且 Azure SQL 数据库、Azure SQL 托管实例、Fabric SQL 数据库均默认开启<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">加速数据库恢复（Accelerated Database Recovery，ADR）</strong>。</p>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h2 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: transparent; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: center; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: #e7642b; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; align-items: unset; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 3px 11px 3px 11px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">内部碎片与外部碎片</span></h2>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">谈及索引碎片时，实际上包含两种完全不同的现象。二者可通过 <code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats</code> 里两个不同字段进行度量，成因各不相同，<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">最重要的是二者带来的性能开销差异巨大</strong>。</p>
<h3 style="display: flex; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #424b5d; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;">数据文件的组织形式</span></h3>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">想要理解碎片，先要搞清楚 SQL Server 如何看待数据文件。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">对普通程序而言，文件就是操作系统提供给程序的字节数组：字节0、字节1、字节2，依此类推。程序读取文件就是请求一段连续范围：文件偏移量 + 读取长度。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">SQL Server 将这一字节数组切分为<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">8KB大小，8KB大小就是一个数据页</strong>。第N号页，对应的字节范围就是 <code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">N × 8192</code> 至 <code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">(N+1) × 8192 − 1</code>。页ID不只是一个标识，它是文件内的地址。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">文件底层的所有存储层（NTFS簇、SSD、SAN卷）都由存储栈做地址转换并对数据库屏蔽。</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" style="border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: #ffffff; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 0px 0px 10px 0px; display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; margin: 20px 0px 20px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="text-indent: 0em; color: #424b5d; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">下文中提到的<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">物理顺序</strong>，均指<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">数据文件内部的数据页排列顺序</strong>，而非硬件磁盘上的实际存放位置。</p>

</blockquote>

<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/01390dd4-0897-41c0-a7cc-e86298fad6ba.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="display: flex; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #424b5d; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;">碎片形态</span></h3>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">1. 内部碎片：数据页没有填满</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">内部碎片指索引的数据页中存在空闲空间。可通过<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">avg_page_space_used_in_percent</strong>（平均页空间使用率百分比）衡量，该指标也叫页密度。</p>
<h4 style="display: flex; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #424b5d; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;">内部碎片从何产生？</span></h4>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
delete语句删除操作，尤其是零散删除：数据行被移除，但数据页仍然保留。
</li>
<li>
页拆分：当一个数据页已满，在键值区间中间位置执行插入，或是更新操作导致行长度变大时，会把约一半的数据行迁移到新分配的数据页上。拆分后的两个页面的填充程度大约都只有 50%。
</li>
<li>
会缩短变长列长度的更新操作。
</li>
<li>
难以紧凑存放的大行长行：一行数据 5000 字节，意味着每页只能存一行，每页会固定有约 38% 的空间被浪费。
</li>

</ol>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" style="border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: #ffffff; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 0px 0px 10px 0px; display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; margin: 20px 0px 20px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="text-indent: 0em; color: #424b5d; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">注意：存在一部分空闲空间一般属于正常现象，有的甚至是刻意预留的：填充因子（fill factor）预留的空间就是人为制造的内部碎片，目的是承接后续的插入操作，避免触发页拆分。</p>

</blockquote>
<h4 style="display: flex; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #424b5d; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0em; font-weight: bold; display: block;">内部碎片是什么表现？</span></h4>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>CREATE&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;DemoFrag
GO

ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;DemoFrag&nbsp;SET&nbsp;RECOVERY&nbsp;SIMPLE
GO

USE&nbsp;DemoFrag
GO

CREATE&nbsp;TABLE&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo&nbsp;(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Id&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int&nbsp;NOT&nbsp;NULL&nbsp;CONSTRAINT&nbsp;PK_SplitDemo&nbsp;PRIMARY&nbsp;KEY&nbsp;CLUSTERED,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Payload&nbsp;varchar(8000)&nbsp;NOT&nbsp;NULL
);

--&nbsp;2&nbsp;lines&nbsp;about&nbsp;4000&nbsp;bytes&nbsp;per&nbsp;page
INSERT&nbsp;INTO&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo&nbsp;VALUES
(1,&nbsp;REPLICATE('A',&nbsp;4000)),&nbsp;(2,&nbsp;REPLICATE('B',&nbsp;4000));</code></pre>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">页面几乎已满： <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/5788360a-c5c7-4e54-939c-227f11018e98.jpg" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">为什么它会产生开销？</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">因为同样的数据行分散到了多于必要数量的数据页上，SQL Server 的所有操作都以数据页为单位：缓冲池缓存的是数据页，而不是数据行。填充密度为 40% 的数据页，会浪费其所占内存的 60%。无论是逻辑读还是物理读，</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">1.读取相同数据都需要处理更多的数据页。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">2.备份文件体积更大</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">3.数据库完整性校验耗时更久。</p>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/e92d5a61-31fe-4f9c-b745-c1f39cf0ba53.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">重点在于</strong>：内部碎片会随数据存在于各处，包括内存中。它会持续占用内存、I/O 和 CPU 资源，而外部碎片则并非如此。</p>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">2. 外部碎片：页偏移量不再遵循逻辑顺序</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在B树的叶子层级，数据页按照索引键的顺序串联成链表，每个页面的页头中保存两个指针（m_nextPage、m_prevPage）。这条链表就是逻辑顺序，它本身不会出错：根据索引定义，该顺序就是键值的排序顺序。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">外部碎片（也叫逻辑碎片）</strong>指的是：顺着这条链表遍历页，不再等同于按顺序读取磁盘文件。数据页在逻辑上有序，但它们在文件内的偏移位置是无序的。它分为两种形态：</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
空洞：索引的数据页不处于连续偏移位置，中间夹杂着其他对象的数据页或者空闲页。
</li>
<li>
乱序：页的偏移位置是连续的，但链表的前后顺序和物理位置顺序不一致。 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/1f01b0ce-242f-44ee-9c8f-5385a61ea5e0.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
</li>

</ul>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">页236和页247之间的空间就是属于test表的空洞</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">avg_fragmentation_in_percent</code>字段只统计这两种碎片，不做区分。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">fragment_count</code> 和 <code style="color: #eb6161; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px 3px 1px 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(235, 97, 97, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none none solid none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">avg_fragment_size_in_pages</code> 这两个指标才是反映实际开销：它们用来度量连续页块的长度。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">外部碎片从何而来？</strong></p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
多个对象同时扩容：数据库引擎按照分配请求的先后顺序分配区，因此不同对象的页在文件里交错分布，这是数据库运行中的常态。
</li>
<li>
页拆分（Page Split）：新页会在能找到空闲空间的位置分配，很少分配在原页旁边。
</li>
<li>
页释放：大量删除操作，以及索引自动压缩本身，都会造成页释放。
</li>

</ol>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">具体效果是怎样的？</strong></p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>USE&nbsp;DemoFrag
GO
CREATE&nbsp;TABLE&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo&nbsp;(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Id&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int&nbsp;NOT&nbsp;NULL&nbsp;CONSTRAINT&nbsp;PK_SplitDemo&nbsp;PRIMARY&nbsp;KEY&nbsp;CLUSTERED,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Payload&nbsp;varchar(8000)&nbsp;NOT&nbsp;NULL
);
--&nbsp;每页存放两行，每行约4000字节：第1、2行在1个页，3、4行在下一个页
INSERT&nbsp;INTO&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo&nbsp;
VALUES&nbsp;(1,&nbsp;REPLICATE('A',&nbsp;4000)),&nbsp;(2,&nbsp;REPLICATE('B',&nbsp;4000)),&nbsp;
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(3,&nbsp;REPLICATE('C',&nbsp;4000)),&nbsp;(4,&nbsp;REPLICATE('D',&nbsp;4000))

--&nbsp;查看行位置（文件号:页号:槽号）
SELECT&nbsp;Id,&nbsp;sys.fn_PhysLocFormatter(%%physloc%%)&nbsp;AS&nbsp;physical_location
FROM&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo;</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/0bf3fe7c-9d4c-4336-8635-54e274ea8326.jpg" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">表的前两行数据位于376号页，后两行位于378号页。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">那377号页里面存了什么？为什么页不是连续的？</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">因为这张表在Id列上建有聚集索引，所以表以B树数据结构存储。我们查看一下这个B树的分配情况</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>SELECT&nbsp;allocated_page_page_id,&nbsp;page_type_desc,&nbsp;page_level,&nbsp;previous_page_page_id,&nbsp;next_page_page_id
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_database_page_allocations(DB_ID(),&nbsp;OBJECT_ID('dbo.SplitDemo'),1,&nbsp;NULL,&nbsp;'DETAILED');</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/6a93d389-432f-4a72-b6e1-bf386574df0d.jpg" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">很明显可以看到377是索引中间节点页面</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">页面内部数据</strong></p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_page_info&nbsp;(10,&nbsp;1,&nbsp;376,&nbsp;DEFAULT);</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/05ccd6e8-797d-423f-8567-0a6f479a29a7.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_page_info&nbsp;(10,&nbsp;1,&nbsp;378,&nbsp;DEFAULT);</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/a570625c-c1de-4eb9-b51a-f2314f6be9b0.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">执行下面操作进而引发外部碎片的页拆分：</strong></p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;触发页拆分
UPDATE&nbsp;dbo.SplitDemo&nbsp;SET&nbsp;Payload&nbsp;=&nbsp;REPLICATE('B',&nbsp;4100)&nbsp;WHERE&nbsp;Id&nbsp;=&nbsp;2;

--&nbsp;查看页填充密度
SELECT&nbsp;index_level,&nbsp;page_count,&nbsp;avg_page_space_used_in_percent,&nbsp;avg_fragmentation_in_percent,&nbsp;record_count,&nbsp;ghost_record_count,&nbsp;version_ghost_record_count
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(),&nbsp;OBJECT_ID('dbo.SplitDemo'),1,&nbsp;NULL,&nbsp;'SAMPLED')
WHERE&nbsp;alloc_unit_type_desc&nbsp;=&nbsp;'IN_ROW_DATA';</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/f12ebb46-32ab-4b9c-9108-84a926fac6d3.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">页拆分之后：</strong> <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/61079d1d-0fb1-4b7c-a107-e92abb3e3873.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">第1行数据位于376号页面</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">第2行数据位于379号页面</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">第3行数据位于378号页面</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">第4行数据位于378号页面 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/3d284610-f6db-4c70-8584-5d62f3a5c8b7.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">数据库引擎请求新空间，新页面分配在文件的后面，第二行数据复制到第379页，相应的页头指针也要修改，所以一次页拆分往往涉及到几个页面</p>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/42762a2f-eb8f-40f1-bdfc-1be388804dc9.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"> <br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">为什么如今外部碎片带来的开销已经很小？</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">预读（read-ahead）机制可以很好的降低外部碎片产生的性能损耗。扫描索引时，数据库引擎会通过大规模I/O预取数据页，一次I/O读取文件中一段连续范围：一个起始偏移量、一个长度，最大可达512KB。索引页连续时，一次I/O就能读取64个数据页；如果不连续，同样一批表数据页就要通过多次更小的I/O读取。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
零散I/O会在什么时候产生明显负面影响？必须同时满足三个条件：
</li>

</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
数据为冷数据：页如果已经在缓冲池中，完全不会产生物理I/O；
</li>
<li>
查询操作是大范围扫描：索引查找是依靠页ID遍历B树，并不关心数据页的物理顺序；
</li>
<li>
每多一次物理I/O都要付出可观耗时。 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/2b6817fc-2529-43da-8088-a5089c69a133.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
</li>

</ol>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">从用户最直接的视角来看，如果页面号距离相差太大，一次预读可能覆盖不到所需要的结果页面（假如预读只读取了page178到page242 总共64个页面），但是结果页面需要page247，那么就需要再增加一次物理读把所需页面读进内存。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在SSD、NVMe以及ESSD云盘云存储上，新增一次物理I/O通常只需要数十微秒，而且文件下层的物理存放位置本身就是不固定的（SSD固态硬盘控制器、SAN存储局域网可以随意放置数据块）。 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/7caad1c8-2ce1-4ec1-bb89-7853521bdc92.jpg" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">外部碎片指标至今仍被关注是因为还有另一个原因：它是一个很好的信号指标。外部碎片增多往往源于页拆分，而页拆分又会降低页填充密度（增加内部碎片）、放大数据库事务日志的写入量。</p>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">为什么索引碎片的影响不像以前那么大了？</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">逻辑碎片在机械硬盘时代是个难题，对存在碎片的索引执行有序扫描时，预读机制会被拆分成多次小规模I/O，每一次地址跳转都需要移动磁头。而在SSD、NVMe和云存储上，非顺序读取带来的性能损耗几乎微乎其微。另外，我们过去费心维护的“物理顺序”，仅仅是数据库数据文件内部数据页的顺序；在这一层之下，文件系统、SSD控制器以及存储层可以随意存放数据块。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">对应关系：</strong></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">内部碎片 = 页填充密度 （AIC功能可以处理这种问题）</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">外部碎片 = 页的逻辑顺序 （AIC功能无办法处理，甚至可能造成更多外部碎片）</p>


</li>

</ul>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">索引自动压缩AIC的工作原理是什么？</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">索引自动压缩并不是一个独立的隐藏维护任务，它的功能由一个已有的后台线程额外承担：PVS清理器是<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">加速数据库恢复（ADR)</strong> 的其中一个组件。要提醒的是，即使不开启ADR功能PVS清理器线程默认也会启动。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">核心原理</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">PVS清理器会定期访问近期发生过修改（插入、更新、删除）的数据页，清理过时的行版本（如果开启了ADR功能）。 当开启索引自动压缩时，该清理器还会检查当前访问页是否存在空闲空间（fill factor填充因子预留的空间除外）。 如果有空闲空间，它会把下一页的数据行迁移到当前页，只要能容纳数据行就会持续不断执行，并且会对几组连续的页面重复执行该操作。 如果某个页面因此变为空页，就会释放该页面。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">达到的效果：</strong> 数据页数量减少、页填充密度提升，存储空间、I/O、CPU以及缓冲池的资源消耗随之下降。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">索引自动压缩的运行机制开销极低，因为它只处理近期被修改过的页面；索引重建或索引重组则会处理全部页面，二者不一样。和索引重组类似，索引自动压缩操作也会获取短期的页排他锁来迁移数据行。如果无法立刻获取锁，就先跳过该页面，后续再尝试处理。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">一条命令即可开启，无需重启数据库，不需要独占访问。压缩操作在几分钟内就会启动。</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;Enable&nbsp;the&nbsp;feature
ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;[SQL-DB-1]&nbsp;SET&nbsp;AUTOMATIC_INDEX_COMPACTION&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON;

--&nbsp;Check&nbsp;if&nbsp;it's&nbsp;enabled
SELECT&nbsp;name,&nbsp;is_automatic_index_compaction_on&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;sys.databases;</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/d19fa706-755f-4431-8015-e5ba40b53fc7.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">开启该功能前有一个重点需要注意</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">PVS清理器线程<strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">只处理开启功能之后发生修改的数据页</strong>。如果你的索引当前页填充密度已经很低，可能需要先执行一次索引重组或索引重建来修复存量问题。在此之后，自动压缩机制会持续维持索引的紧凑状态，无需人工干预。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">演示流程</strong></p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>创建一张带聚集主键的表，并插入500万行数据</li>
<li>采集基准指标：页数量、页填充密度、碎片程度</li>
<li>删除三分之二的数据行，删除操作分散在整张表中，以此模拟索引膨胀</li>
<li>再次采集指标，然后等待数据库引擎执行索引自动压缩</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">我们先建表，插入5万行数据：</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>CREATE&nbsp;TABLE&nbsp;dbo.Demo&nbsp;(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Id&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;int&nbsp;IDENTITY&nbsp;CONSTRAINT&nbsp;PK_Demo&nbsp;PRIMARY&nbsp;KEY&nbsp;CLUSTERED,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Payload&nbsp;char(400)&nbsp;NOT&nbsp;NULL&nbsp;DEFAULT&nbsp;REPLICATE('X',&nbsp;400)
);

INSERT&nbsp;INTO&nbsp;dbo.Demo&nbsp;(Payload)
SELECT&nbsp;TOP&nbsp;(50000)&nbsp;REPLICATE('X',&nbsp;400)
FROM&nbsp;sys.all_columns&nbsp;a&nbsp;CROSS&nbsp;JOIN&nbsp;sys.all_columns&nbsp;b;</code></pre>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/9c32c401-226b-4f00-8ff9-3fbab6e6aaa1.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"> <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/af67132c-0923-47f1-94b5-e87a1701d309.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">采集基准指标：</strong></p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>SELECT&nbsp;index_level,&nbsp;page_count,&nbsp;avg_page_space_used_in_percent,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;avg_fragmentation_in_percent,&nbsp;record_count
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(),&nbsp;OBJECT_ID('dbo.Demo'),1,&nbsp;NULL,&nbsp;'SAMPLED')
WHERE&nbsp;alloc_unit_type_desc&nbsp;=&nbsp;'IN_ROW_DATA';</code></pre>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">此时内部碎片水平较低。 得到的结果如下： <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/d0d784de-45ea-41df-9871-b06610bd7484.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">当前数据库中的页面类似于下面这样，比较稠密 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/1c42032c-b7cf-4364-a0f5-7360506dc2ed.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">人为制造索引膨胀</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">我们删除表中三分之二的数据行，删除记录均匀分布在整张表里。没有任何数据页变为空页，每个页面大约只保留三分之一的数据行，页填充密度随之下降：</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>DELETE&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;dbo.Demo&nbsp;WHERE&nbsp;Id&nbsp;%&nbsp;3&nbsp;&lt;&gt;&nbsp;0;</code></pre>
<img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/b1527978-3b31-490e-afba-a69b04c8c1c1.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">如果没有开启索引自动压缩AIC，页面数量维持在2778（单纯delete删除不会释放非空数据页），页密度降至约31%（94.93%的三分之一），数据行只剩下16666行。</p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">再次采集指标</strong> <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/c550afef-1b85-4ce3-8e03-c49a6b1dea2b.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">当前数据库中的页面类似于下面这样，比较稀疏 <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/2f100724-414a-411c-9e0c-f9bcae12a5e8.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"></p>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">这时候开启索引自动压缩AIC功能，等待数据库引擎完成后台处理，再次核查指标</strong> <img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/75777/5ecd313e-41f7-4f3a-9e05-935e18048bd1.png" alt="" style="display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto 0px auto;"> 数据库在全程正常对外提供服务的同时，由后台数据库引擎完成索引压缩合并工作。 可以看到页面数量减少到929，页密度增加约94%，数据行依然是16666行。</p>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">目前的一些限制</strong></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">自动数据库索引压缩合并功能不会更新统计信息。索引重建会更新统计信息，如果你原本依靠索引重建任务更新统计信息，仍然需要保留统计信息更新任务。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">它无法降低外部碎片（逻辑碎片），正如演示中所见，外部碎片甚至可能升高。对绝大多数业务负载而言，不会产生可观测的性能影响。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">它不会重新生成填充因子预留的空闲空间，只有索引重建任务才会。对于需要将填充因子设置为小于100%以减少页拆分的业务场景，仍然需要不定期执行索引重建任务。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">它不会收缩数据文件。数据的已使用空间会减少，但数据文件的已分配大小保持不变。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">该功能仅适用于行内数据（IN_ROW_DATA）分配单元中B树索引的叶子层级。堆表、大对象(LOB)数据、行溢出数据、已压缩的列存储行组以及内存优化表均不在支持范围内。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">禁用页锁（ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = OFF）的索引无法使用该功能。</p>


</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">目前我们依然需要 Ola Hallengren 脚本或是自研的运维方案，Ola Hallengren脚本原本是同时维护索引 + 统计信息。由于自动数据库索引压缩合并功能并不维护统计信息，如果不执行单独的统计信息维护作业，后续很可能会出现性能问题。</p>


</li>
</ul>

<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: #424b5d; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: left; background-position-y: top; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">参考</strong></p>
<p style="color: #424b5d; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/indexes/automatic-index-compaction?view=fabric-sqldb</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
